title: security: RBAC v2 KMS region residency audit hardening and region-pinning enforcement
author: Priya Rao
description: Motivation: tighten audit logging and enforcement for RBAC v2 KMS region residency and region-pinning controls after recent compliance review and a customer incident where keys were accessible cross-region. This PR hardens enforcement paths and expands audit metadata so downstream SIEM and privacy teams can confidently demonstrate residency controls. Summary of changes: 1) Add explicit region-residency enforcement checks in RBAC policy evaluation pipeline and introduce fallthrough deny semantics when a request's KMS key region does not match resource residency constraints. 2) Surface KMS key region and requested-region fields in audit logs for every relevant API call (Create/Update/Serve). 3) Add gating config and feature-flagging hooks to progressively enable enforcement per-tenant and per-cluster. 4) Implement migration that backfills residency annotations for existing resources and marks resources that need reconciliation. 5) Add unit and integration test suites and e2e smoke tests for common misconfigurations. Checklist: - [x] RBAC enforcement logic implemented - [x] Audit log schema extended - [x] Migration/backfill implemented - [x] Tests added and CI green - [x] Docs updated with operator migration steps Impact: behavioral change for tenants that have KMS keys in regions that violate pinned residency policies; those requests will now be denied unless an explicit override policy exists. Rolling plan: feature-flagged on by default in staging for 1 week, opt-in in prod for first rollout, then opt-out when enforcement metrics are stable.
